boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed downtown destinations on corridors just beyond the University of Michigan’s central campus.

cards.title: Michigan Theater: see the historic auditorium
cards.subtitle: East Liberty Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the theater calendar, then photograph the restored marquee and lobby before your show. Ticket requirements vary by event.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown venue with films and live programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michigan Theater is located at 603 E. Liberty Street and presents films and live events.
cards.access_notes: Review the event listing and ticket details before attending.

cards.title: State Theatre: catch a movie downtown
cards.subtitle: South State Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the current showtimes to pick a screening, and take a street-level photo of the theater’s illuminated facade.
cards.short_summary: A named State Street movie-theater stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Theatre is listed by Marquee Cinema as a theater in Ann Arbor with current showtimes.
cards.access_notes: Screenings and ticket requirements vary; verify showtimes on the theater operator’s site.

cards.title: Downtown Library: browse a 350,000-item collection
cards.subtitle: South Fifth Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or browse the stacks; the Downtown building’s collection includes books, media, and magazines.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop with substantial browsing collections.
cards.evidence_claim: AADL says its Downtown building at 343 S. Fifth Avenue houses nearly 350,000 items.
cards.access_notes: AADL lists the branch as open for browsing, seating, and checkout; obtain a library card for borrowing eligibility.

cards.title: Literati Bookstore: attend an author event
cards.subtitle: East Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Look over the bookstore’s event calendar and arrive early for an in-store reading or discussion when one is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore that publishes an active events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Literati lists upcoming author events and identifies its bookstore at 124 E. Washington Street.
cards.access_notes: Some events require an RSVP or ticket; confirm the individual event page.

cards.title: The Ark: hear folk and roots artists
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse the performance calendar and choose an all-ages-appropriate show; the venue’s entrance is at 316 S. Main.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit listening room focused on folk and roots music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ark describes itself as a 400-seat venue for folk and roots performers at 316 S. Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Tickets and age policies can differ by performance; confirm details on the selected event listing.

cards.title: Kerrytown Market & Shops: browse the indoor shops
cards.subtitle: North Fifth Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the courtyard and consult the tenant directory to choose a shop or eatery that fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: A multi-tenant historic market building with shops and eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Kerrytown Market & Shops at 407 N. Fifth Avenue describes its offerings as specialty markets, gift shops, and eateries.
cards.access_notes: Building and individual-tenant hours differ; check the directory before going.

cards.title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market: meet local vendors
cards.subtitle: Detroit Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the market schedule, then walk the vendor stalls and community tables; bring a reusable bag if you plan to buy.
cards.short_summary: A city-operated public market in the Kerrytown area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ann Arbor describes the Ann Arbor Farmers Market as a historic market with vendors, community tables, and seasonal food trucks or pop-ups.
cards.source_title: City of Ann Arbor — Ann Arbor Farmers Market
cards.access_notes: Check the City’s current market schedule and vendor information before visiting.

cards.title: Hands-On Museum: use the interactive exhibits
cards.subtitle: East Ann Street corridor
cards.notes: Reserve or buy admission as needed, then leave time to work through the museum’s hands-on science exhibits.
cards.short_summary: An interactive science museum in the downtown core.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum presents interactive science and technology exhibits for visitors.
cards.access_notes: Admission and timed-entry details are set by the museum; check its visit information before arrival.

cards.title: Zingerman’s Delicatessen: order from the deli counter
cards.subtitle: Detroit Street corridor
cards.notes: Review the deli’s menu before you go, then order at the counter or choose carryout for a nearby outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A named Kerrytown-area deli with counter ordering and carryout.
cards.evidence_claim: Zingerman’s lists its Delicatessen at 422 Detroit Street and provides menu, ordering, and carryout information.
cards.access_notes: Food is purchased; check the deli’s current ordering options and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Vault of Midnight: browse comics and games
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the store’s Ann Arbor events and inventory, then browse graphic novels, comics, tabletop games, and supplies.
cards.short_summary: A downtown comics and tabletop-games shop.
cards.evidence_claim: Vault of Midnight identifies its Ann Arbor store and promotes comics, graphic novels, games, and community events.
cards.access_notes: Purchases and event terms vary; confirm the current store calendar before making a trip.
